delta.purpose: Execute the four already-canonical #1092 adapter boundary receipt nodes independently while binding exact source and executor provenance.
fail_closed_guards: bind full HEAD commit and tree
bind canonical test, adapter and runner Git blobs plus file SHA-256 at execution time
bind Python executable identity, Python version, pytest version evidence and Git version evidence
execute each fixed node separately with 120-second timeout
persist per-node return code, duration, stdout/stderr digest and byte count, and failure-signature digest
reject checkout that becomes dirty during execution

evidence.note: Prior synthetic runner checks support the mechanism only. They do not transfer exact-runtime credit to this fresh canonical-node runner.

next_gate: Run the committed runner from a clean exact Ubuntu checkout of this branch or a rebased descendant.
Require source.commit/tree and test/adapter/runner identities in the emitted receipt to match the executed checkout.
If all four nodes pass, rerun the complete suite before classifying the historical 1486/1 red as fixed or metrology-related.
If a node fails, give defect credit only to that exact phase and preserve the other independent receipts.
